SAP Security Patch Day – October 2026
This post shares the information on security notes that remediate vulnerabilities discovered in SAP products. SAP strongly recommends that the customer visits the
support portal
and applies patches on priority to protect their SAP landscape.
On 13
th
of October 2026, SAP security patch day saw the release of 16 new security notes and 4 GitHub security advisories. There are 2 updates to previously released security notes.
